shots.title: X01 · Enrichment on pin
shots.caption: Enrichment on pin: the moment an indicator lands on the board the server looks it up once (RDAP owner, ASN, country; for domains DNS, registrar and age, certificate log; for CVEs CVSS and KEV; for wallets balance; VirusTotal and MalwareBazaar when keyed). The result is written into the card body and tags. A CDN or cloud address is tagged shared-infra with a warning, so it is not blocklisted on its own.
marks: Shared-infrastructure warning written on the card
Enrichment block: RDAP, ASN, country, dates

shots.title: X02 · Watchers
shots.caption: Watchers: pick an indicator, choose the interval and the checks (DNS, certificate log, blocklist, wallet, NVD), optionally a webhook, and "Watch it". The server re-checks on schedule; when something changes an event card lands in the case inbox, you are notified, and the webhook is called. "Run now" checks immediately.

shots.title: X03 · Duplicates
shots.caption: Duplicate finder: cards with the same indicator value, technique id or title are grouped; "Merge into one" keeps the pinned card, re-points threads and unions tags, tasks and comments.
marks: Merge the group into one card

shots.title: X04 · Actors and ATT&CK
shots.caption: Actor library and ATT&CK: add or update actors (name, aliases, origin, motive, techniques, summary) or import a STIX bundle / MISP galaxy; they merge into the board's Actor library. Admins can download the full MITRE Enterprise matrix so every technique id resolves to a name and tactic.

shots.title: X05 · Actor library with server actors
shots.caption: The board's Actor library now lists the server-defined SafePay entry next to the built-in groups; Drop in pins the actor with its techniques threaded.
